The object has a central spherical body surrounded by a ring-like structure, with long, thin, tentacle-like appendages hanging downward. In the background, there is a hazy, dark shoreline or cliffside, and some indistinct, blurry shapes that could be interpreted as birds or small flying craft. The overall style resembles a vintage charcoal or ink wash drawing.
